identification: Two boxes of loose 1980s toys, sold as is. Lower box is G.I. Joe A Real American Hero (Hasbro) vehicles, parts, figures and accessories. The white tracked vehicle with olive-green canopy and USA flag decal IS consistent with the 1985 Snow Cat (Google Images matched the white hull, grey-green canopy and tracks; incomplete, no missiles or driver visible). The large orange-yellow hull with yellow outriggers is NOT a Killer W.H.A.L.E.: Google Images shows the 1984 Killer W.H.A.L.E. hovercraft is an olive-green/grey hull with black skirt, fan cages and a cutter boat, nothing like this orange-yellow hull. So there is no Killer W.H.A.L.E. visible; I could not identify the yellow hull (searched orange/yellow G.I. Joe boats, Devilfish, Hydrofoil, Adventure Team vehicles without a clean match). Also a grey angular pylon/gantry, purple/black parts, many loose figures and accessories. Upper clear tub is later die-cast cars, Hot Wheels type, monster trucks, a Toy Story Rex and a red capsule ball.
marks_seen: Photo resolution is low (about 350 px wide). White hull has small printed text and a USA flag decal, text not legible; yellow hull has decal panels, text not legible. No Hasbro copyright stamps readable.
google_searches: Google Images: GI Joe Killer WHALE hovercraft 1984 (olive green, ruled out the yellow hull); GI Joe vintage yellow orange vehicle with outriggers; GI Joe 1980s orange yellow boat vehicle (no match found); GI Joe Snow Cat 1985 vehicle (matches the white vehicle).

identification: Mixed lot: woven rattan tray, green faux-malachite painted metal oval planter, printed tin with woven-basket pattern and lid, and a part chandelier. Photos at full size (about 350 px wide, low resolution) show the chandelier is a gilt/bronzed tole grape-and-vine-leaf chandelier with bunches of gold grapes, a central stem and chain, a shell-shaped fluted cap at the bottom, and at least 2 visible candle arms with dished leaf bobeches (probably 3 arms, one hidden). Italian Florentine tole style, probably 1950s-60s, origin not proven. Looks complete in shape but untested, with loose wiring and no shades. The chandelier is the only item with real value.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 40-60, current bid $10 (re-checked 9 Nov), 22% premium. Andy should check at the viewing: arm count, whether all leaves/grapes are present and not bent, rust or flaking gilt, wiring (needs rewiring and an electrician to be sold to be used), and the weight/size for posting. eBay sold prices for 3 to 5 arm grape tole chandeliers cluster A$145 to A$330, with complete or crystal-fitted ones up to A$580; poor auction examples go far lower (Brooks US$24 in 2021). Most prices are within 2 years (2024 to Oct 2026) and look flat; the 2021 and 2022 auction results are older. Most Terapeak sales are eBay US listings, so US buyers paid the price and postage; fragile and bulky to post from Tasmania. The other items in the lot (tray, planter, tin) are minor.

flip_reason: About 10 same-style tole grape chandelier sales (3 to 5 arm) in the last 2 years, typical A$145 to A$330 on eBay US, A$190 for a restoration one on eBay AU, but they are bulky and fragile, wiring untested, and one auction example went for US$24. Current bid $10 (about $12 with premium). Profit over $200 only if it is complete and the gilt is good; needs a viewing.
